title: Understanding the Model Equation
text: The model equation is given as:\n\( \hat{y}=-8+3x_{edu}+6x_{m}-3x_{b} \)\nHere, \( x_{edu} \) is the years of education, \( x_{m} \) is the dummy variable for managerial workers, and \( x_{b} \) is the dummy variable for blue collar workers.

title: Identifying the Variables
text:
For a blue collar worker with $$10$$ years of education:
- \( x_{edu} $$=$$ $$10$$ \)
- \( x_{m} $$=$$ $$0$$ \) (since the worker is not managerial)
- \( x_{b} $$=$$ $$1$$ \) (since the worker is blue collar)

title: Substitute the Values
text: Substitute the values into the model equation:\n\( $$\hat{y}=-8+3\left(10\right)+6\left(0\right)-3\left(1\right)$$ \)

title: Final Calculation
text: Simplify the expression to find the predicted wage:\n\( $$\hat{y}=19$$ \)
